description: Lay a make_short format's layers on its rendered video: its picture layers, the pauses between lines cut out (free), the format's captions (the spoken words, transcribed and burned in its look) and its "Comment KEYWORD" card, timed to the moment the presenter says "comment". Nothing else is laid: only what the format (or the keyword you chose) names. Pass the rendered video's url and the creative make_short returned. Runs as ordinary jobs (subtitles about 2-6 credits by length, the card about 2), each landing in the Library. When a step is still rendering the reply says so with its job id: get_job it, then call again with its result as `video` and the given `fromStep`.

creative.description: the FULL creative the short-format plan returned (it carries `shorts`)

fromStep.description: resume from this step (a previous reply names it); default 0

video.description: the rendered video (render_ad / get_job url); a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: finish_short
title: Finish a short (lay its format)
